definitions.L1_DEPTH_RATIO_MAX: (bid1 + ask1 notional at T) / median of the previous 168 hourly values (>= 120): <= cut
definitions.L2_ASYM_ASK_HEAVY_MAX: log(bid1 / ask1) at T: <= cut (comparator arm)
definitions.L2_ASYM_BID_HEAVY_MIN: log(bid1 / ask1) at T: >= cut (state arm)
definitions.L3_RECOVERY_MAX: depth at move end + 30 min / depth 15 min before the move end (DH1 sharp move): <= cut
definitions.O2_DVOL_JUMP_MIN: log(DVOL candle T-1h close / DVOL candle T-2h close): >= cut
definitions.P1_DOI4_MIN: log(OI_T / OI_T-4h) (metrics snapshot labelled bar j's open, used at bar j's close): >= cut
definitions.P1_QUIET_RANGE_MAX: log((max high - min low) / close) over the 48 bars ending at T: <= cut is a quiet hour
definitions.P2_DOI1_MAX: log(OI_T / OI_T-1h): <= cut is the deleveraging state
definitions.P3_CROWD_Z_LONG_MIN: same z: >= cut is the crowd-long state
definitions.P3_CROWD_Z_SHORT_MAX: z of count_long_short_ratio vs the previous 720 hourly values (>= 600 finite): <= cut
definitions.S3_LARGE_PRINTS_Q67: number of perp aggTrades >= 1M USD in a stress hour: > max(cut, 0) is the state
definitions.S_STRESS_HOUR_LOG_RANGE_MIN: UTC hour perp log range (max high / min low of its 12 5m bars): >= cut

purpose: frozen DH3 state cut points for live research-evidence matching; never recomputed on live data
symbol: BTC (Binance USD-M BTCUSDT; card L and O cuts are the BTC-specific ones)
